+import re
+import sys
+from collections import defaultdict
+from operator import itemgetter
+from wordcloud.tokenization import unigrams_and_bigrams, process_tokens
+
+def debug_process_text(self, text):
+    """Debug version of process_text to see what's happening"""
+    print(f"Input text: {text}")
+    print(f"min_word_length: {self.min_word_length}")
+    
+    flags = (re.UNICODE if sys.version < '3' and type(text) is unicode  # noqa: F821
+             else 0)
+    pattern = r"\w[\w']*" if self.min_word_length <= 1 else r"\w[\w']+"
+    regexp = self.regexp if self.regexp is not None else pattern
+    
+    print(f"Using pattern: {pattern}")
+    words = re.findall(regexp, text, flags)
+    print(f"Words after regex: {words}")
+    
+    # remove 's
+    words = [word[:-2] if word.lower().endswith("'s") else word
+             for word in words]
+    print(f"Words after removing 's: {words}")
+    
+    # remove numbers
+    if not self.include_numbers:
+        words = [word for word in words if not word.isdigit()]
+    print(f"Words after removing numbers: {words}")
+    
+    # remove short words
+    if self.min_word_length:
+        words = [word for word in words if len(word) >= self.min_word_length]
+    print(f"Words after length filter: {words}")
+    
+    stopwords = set([i.lower() for i in self.stopwords])
+    print(f"Stopwords: {stopwords}")
+    
+    if self.collocations:
+        print("Using collocations path")
+        word_counts = unigrams_and_bigrams(words, stopwords, self.normalize_plurals, self.collocation_threshold)
+    else:
+        print("Using non-collocations path")
+        # remove stopwords
+        words = [word for word in words if word.lower() not in stopwords]
+        print(f"Words after removing stopwords: {words}")
+        word_counts, _ = process_tokens(words, self.normalize_plurals)
+        print(f"Final word_counts: {word_counts}")
+    
+    return word_counts
+
+# Monkey patch for debugging
+from wordcloud import WordCloud
+WordCloud.debug_process_text = debug_process_text
+

+print(f"Returned result: {result}")
